feeds.title: Rosti Blog
feeds.description: Read stories about plastic injection molding, 3D printing, scientific molding, exotic resins, and much more. Rosti entered the plastics manufacturing industry in 1989, as a small facility, with a few presses and a vague plan to build a 'fully-automated' plant. Since our humble beginnings, we have grown to become one of the most revolutionary manufacturers of medium and high-volume, small and medium-sized plastic injection molded parts worldwide.

We promise to deliver our absolute best through quality, timeliness, relationships, and sustainability. Find news and notes from around the league.

feeds.title: Deluxe Plastics Blog
feeds.description: Gain insight into injection molding plastics, techniques, and news with the Deluxe Plastics Blog. As a full-service custom injection molder, Deluxe Plastics provides quality injection molding, part design, and mold building services for a variety of industries including appliances, hygiene, industrial, and commercial.

feeds.title: Routsis Training Blog
feeds.description: This informative blog allows plastics professionals to discuss plastics training and technology. Routsis Training programs are used in hundreds of facilities by thousands of people worldwide. We deliver comprehensive training for all skill levels to both individuals and companies, large and small; combining traditional hands-on learning with interactive online training courses.

feeds.title: Allegheny Performance Plastics Blog
feeds.description: Allegheny is the 'go to' high-end injection molder, manufacturer, and global supplier of technically advanced functional parts and assemblies, used in products including gears, transmissions, and pumps, made from high-temperature, high-performance specialty thermoplastics. For over 85 years, Allegheny Performance Plastics has been a pioneer in working with high-temperature, high-performance, specialty thermoplastics.
